I scarcely know what made you ask, inasmuch as I had said nothing to excite your curiosity.

arxiv-1903-10415.title: Evidence for the production of three massive vector bosons with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1903-10415.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-1903-10415.description: Abstract A search for the production of three massive vector bosons in proton–proton collisions is performed using data at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV recorded with the ATLAS detector at the Large Hadron Collider in the years 2015–2017, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 79.8 79.8 fb -1 .

arxiv-2302-11609.title: Modelling gas around galaxy pairs and groups using the Q0107 quasar triplet 2023 Modelling gas around galaxy pairs and groups using the Q0107 quasar triplet – 15
arxiv-2302-11609.creator: Alexander Beckett, Simon L. Morris, Michele Fumagalli, Nicolas Tejos, Buell Jannuzi, Sebastiano Cantalupo
arxiv-2302-11609.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alexander Beckett, Simon L. Morris, Michele Fumagalli, Nicolas Tejos, Buell Jannuzi, Sebastiano Cantalupo. We examine to what extent disk and outflow models can reproduce observations of H i gas within a few virial radii of galaxies in pairs and groups.

arxiv-2304-14060.title: Unsteady granular chute flows at high inertial numbers
arxiv-2304-14060.creator: Satyabrata Patro, Sumit Kumar, Anubhav Majumdar, Anurag Tripathi
arxiv-2304-14060.description: Abstract We study the time-dependent flow behavior of gravity-driven free surface granular flows using the discrete element method and continuum modeling. Discrete element method (DEM) simulations of slightly polydisperse disks flowing over a periodic chute with a bumpy base are performed.

arxiv-2501-08963.title: Training-Aware Risk Control for Intensity Modulated Radiation Therapies Quality Assurance with Conformal Prediction
arxiv-2501-08963.creator: Kevin He, David Adam, Sarah Han-Oh, Anqi Liu
arxiv-2501-08963.description: Abstract Measurement quality assurance (QA) practices play a key role in the safe use of Intensity Modulated Radiation Therapies (IMRT) for cancer treatment. These practices have reduced measurement-based IMRT QA failure below 1%. However, these practices are time and labor intensive which can lead to delays in patient care.

arxiv-2502-14006.title: Im2SurfTex: Surface Texture Generation via Neural Backprojection of Multi-View Images
arxiv-2502-14006.creator: Yiangos Georgiou 1,2 , Marios Loizou 1,2,3 , Melinos Averkiou 1,2 and Evangelos Kalogerakis 2,3 1 University of Cyprus 2 CYENS CoE 3 Technical University of Crete
arxiv-2502-14006.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yiangos Georgiou 1,2 , Marios Loizou 1,2,3 , Melinos Averkiou 1,2 and Evangelos Kalogerakis 2,3 1 University of Cyprus 2 CYENS CoE 3 Technical University of Crete. We present Im2SurfTex, a method that generates textures for input 3D shapes by learning to aggregate multi-view image outputs produced by 2D image diffusion models onto the shapes’ texture space.

arxiv-2504-02054.title: Grotthuss-type oxygen hole polaron transport in desodiated Na 2 Mn 3 O 7
arxiv-2504-02054.creator: Ming Lei, Iwnetim I. Abate
arxiv-2504-02054.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ming Lei, Iwnetim I. Abate. Polarons are quasiparticles that arise from the coupling of electrons or holes with ionic vibrations in polarizable materials. Typically, they are either localized at a single atomic site or delocalized over multiple sites. However, after the desodiation of Na 2 Mn 3 O 7 , we identify a rare split-hole polaron, where a single hole is shared between two adjacent oxygen atoms rather than fully localized or delocalized.

pmc-11529726.title: Paradoxical cerebral embolism three decades after mustard surgery in a patient with complete transposition of the great arteries: a case report
pmc-11529726.creator: Kosuke Matsuzono, Masayuki Suzuki, Takafumi Mashiko, Reiji Koide, Shigeru Fujimoto
pmc-11529726.description: Atrial switch procedures such as the Mustard operation were previously popular for the complete transposition of the great arteries (i.e. dextro-transposition of the great arteries [d-TGA]). Patients with d-TGA who underwent atrial switch procedures approximately three decades ago have now entered adulthood.

pmc-11971824.title: Carriage of multiple resistance genes by community and hospital isolates of Stenotrophomonas maltophilia resistant to the first-line drug of choice in Nigeria
pmc-11971824.creator: David Olusoga Ogbolu, Oyebode Armstrong Terry Alli, Adeolu Sunday Oluremi, Deborah Iyanu Ojebode, Yetunde Temilola Ogunjimi, Mark Alexander Webber
pmc-11971824.description: Stenotrophomonas maltophilia (S. maltophilia) has emerged as an important nosocomial pathogen and causes life-threatening infections among the vulnerable, and occasionally in immunocompetent individuals. We examined the mechanisms of multidrug resistance in S. maltophilia isolated from sick and healthy individuals in Nigeria. Susceptibility testing and genome sequencing revealed multidrug resistance and carriage of multiple antimicrobial resistance genes in all isolates.

pmc-12432999.title: PD1/PDL1 and TIM3/Gal9 expression in acute lymphoblastic leukemia: Gal-9 expression on leukemia stem cells as an independent prognostic parameter
pmc-12432999.creator: Azza M. Kamel, Abdallah M. Almuslimani, Eman Z. Kandil, Marwa Hanafy, Mohammed AM Samra, Youssef MS Madney, Randa A. Osman
pmc-12432999.description: The introduction of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI) which are designed not to activate the immune system to attack tumors but to eliminate the inhibitory signals that block antitumor T-cell responses represents a breakthrough in the treatment of malignancies. However, studies in acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) patients are scarce in number and in the parameters addressed.

pmc-12524397.title: Recovery Time of Electrical Sensory, Motor, and Pain Thresholds: A Pilot Study Towards Standardization of Quantitative Sensory Testing in Healthy Population
pmc-12524397.creator: Izarbe Ríos-Asín, Miguel Malo-Urriés, Jorge Pérez-Rey, Marta García-Díez, Lucía Burgos-Garlito, Elena Bueno-Gracia, Luk Hsiang Ning
pmc-12524397.description: Background/Objectives: Electrical threshold testing (ETT) offers a promising method for assessing somatosensory function. Despite its growing use, fundamental aspects such as the physiological recovery time required between repeated threshold measurements remain poorly understood. This gap is critical when evaluating sensory, motor, or pain thresholds (EST, EMT, EPT) in pre–post designs or rapid intra-session protocols.

pmc-12580232.title: Identification of Ecological Corridors for Semi‐Aquatic Vertebrates: A Case of the Eurasian Otter in Northeast China
pmc-12580232.creator: Qingyi Wang, Aihua Fu, Wendi Yang, Minhao Chen, Chao Zhang, Xiaofeng Luan
pmc-12580232.description: As an indicator and flagship species of freshwater ecosystems, the Eurasian otter ( Lutra lutra ) plays a significant role in maintaining the connectivity and stability of ecosystems. However, compared with terrestrial and marine ecosystems, the conservation of freshwater ecosystems and species has not been sufficiently emphasized.

pmc-12581060.title: Role of additional topotecan injections (plus two) in reducing recurrence rate in retinoblastoma of group D and group E patients: a retrospective study
pmc-12581060.creator: Xintong Lin, Zhuqing Zheng, Haifeng Chen, Jiang Qian, Qiang Liu, Ruiqi Ma, Kang Xue
pmc-12581060.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the effectiveness of administering additional intravitreal topotecan injections (plus two) in reducing the recurrence rate in patients with advanced retinoblastoma (RB).Methods and analysisThis retrospective, non-comparative and interventional study encompassed 26 eyes of 25 patients with RB, treated between January 2019 and April 2024. All eyes in this series had received previous intravenous chemotherapy and/or intra-arterial chemotherapy.

pmc-13085534.title: Natural killer cells as biomarkers for disease activity, lupus nephritis, and time to remission in treatment-naïve childhood-onset systemic lupus erythematosus: a cohort study
pmc-13085534.creator: Tianyi Luo, Sihao Gao, Tianyu Zhang, Ting Li, Siming Peng, Yufan Jiang, Caihui Zhang, Yu Zhou, Zhongxun Yu, Mingsheng Ma, Hongmei Song
pmc-13085534.description: ObjectivesAdaptive immunity is well-established in lupus pathogenesis, yet the clinical significance of innate immune components, particularly natural killer (NK) cells, remains underexplored. This study aims to evaluate the clinical relevance of NK cell levels in treatment-naïve, infection-free patients with childhood-onset systemic lupus erythematosus (cSLE).MethodsWe conducted a retrospective cohort study among 96 treatment-naïve, infection-free cSLE patients diagnosed during 2015–2025.

pmc-13178397.title: Clinical characteristics and imaging analysis of Proteus syndrome: a case description
pmc-13178397.creator: Xiaoxin Qin, Liuyan Yang, Xingqin Wei, Zhongjun Liao, Guangming Cheng, Hao Wei, Lu Jiang, Hui Qin, Wenhua Qin, Meixian Wu, Dejian Yuan
pmc-13178397.description: to diagnostic challenges and frequent misdiagnosis. With an estimated incidence of less than 1 in 1,000,000 (1), the condition derives its name from the Greek sea god Proteus, reflecting its variable and changing morphology (2,3). This report describes a case of an adolescent patient with typical Proteus syndrome as confirmed through genetic testing.

pmc-13516317.title: Building Tobacco Treatment Capacity and Sustainability: A Qualitative Study on Implementation of Community Pharmacy Technicians as Community Health Workers
pmc-13516317.creator: Cindy V. Valencia, Robin L. Corelli, Shin-Ping Tu, Melissa M. Gosdin, Elisa K. Tong
pmc-13516317.description: Community pharmacies are increasingly providing health care services like tobacco treatment and disease-related management but need sustainable models for implementation. As several state Medicaid programs reimburse for community health worker (CHW) services, one promising model is to have pharmacy technicians engage with patients as designated CHWs.

pmc-13669044.title: Accounting for response styles in rating data using IRT and IRTree models: A tutorial in R with applications to self-reported metacognitive competence
pmc-13669044.creator: Thorsten Meiser, Esther Ulitzsch, Mirka Henninger
pmc-13669044.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Response styles refer to individual differences in the use of the item response format irrespective of item content. They include tendencies to favor or avoid midpoint or extreme response categories, which can distort the measurement of latent constructs. This tutorial provides an overview of IRT and IRTree models that accommodate response style factors, allowing researchers to analyze response-style effects and adjust latent-trait estimates for potential bias.

uslaw-usc-t47-s1432.title: 47 U.S.C. § 1432 — Prohibition on direct offering of commercial telecommunications service directly to consumers
uslaw-usc-t47-s1432.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t47-s1432.description: United States Code, Title 47 (Telecommunications); Chapter 13 (Public Safety Communications And Electromagnetic Spectrum Auctions); Subchapter II (Governance Of Public Safety Spectrum). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general The First Responder Network Authority shall not offer, provide, or market commercial telecommunications or information services directly to consumers. (b) Rule of construction Nothing in this section shall be construed to prohibit.
